app.name: Dashboard Migrator
app.description: Translate classic dashboards and their queries into DQL and new dashboards.

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Translate: check that translated metric keys exist (metrics command) and preview timeseries queries

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Translate: classicEntitySelector() filters, entityName() and entity tile previews

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Translate: preview queries that read smartscape nodes

scopes.name: storage:user.sessions:read
scopes.comment: Translate: preview USQL tiles translated to user.sessions

scopes.name: storage:user.events:read
scopes.comment: Translate: preview USQL useraction tiles translated to user.events

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Translate: preview log tiles translated to fetch logs

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Translate: preview problem and event tiles

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Translate: read the Grail buckets behind logs, events and problems (dt.davis.problems)

scopes.name: document:documents:read
scopes.comment: Export: list dashboards this app created earlier

scopes.name: document:documents:write
scopes.comment: Export: create the new dashboard document

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Classic source: the classic-dashboards function reads the ReadConfig API token from the app settings (plain text only inside the function)

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: Classic source: admins store the ReadConfig API token in the app settings; also checked to decide who may change it

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: read the last imported dashboard and user settings

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:write
scopes.comment: save the last imported dashboard and user settings
